content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Project Associate(I) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 11-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Associate(I) post at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The last date to email your CV for the Project Associate(I) position at IIT Roorkee is 11th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate(I) role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Masters in Physics or equivalent disciplines, or a B.E./B.Tech. degree. Programming knowledge in Python is mandatory, with Fortran and C++ being preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate(I) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate(I) post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 55,000 per month, depending on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the IIT Roorkee Project Associate(I) recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Associate(I) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate(I) position will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Associate(I) post is scheduled to be held on 15th September 2026. Candidates are advised to be present on time.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Project Associate(I) at the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Associate(I) position is a contract-based job at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 247667.
